data.text: A car always has an engine that can be a diesel, gasoline or electric. It will also has some optional assistance systems like lane assist or ESP. There are also different colours for the car.
data.code:
features
    Car
        mandatory
            Engine
                alternative
                    Diesel
                    Gasoline
                    Electric
            Color
                alternative
                    Red
                    Blue
                    White
                    Black
        optional
            AssistanceSystems
                or
                    LaneAssist
                    ESP

data.text: A bicycle is equipped with a groupset (Manufacturer is SRAM or Shimano) and other parts for different use-cases. The gravel bike features wide tyres with some profile, while the road bike has slim tyres with no profile. Both bikes are equipped with a drop bar handlebar, while the mountain bike is equipped with a flat handlebar. It also features extra wide tyres with deep profile. It is also possible to fit the slim tyres on the gravel bike.
data.code:
features
    Bicycle
        mandatory
            Groupset
                alternative
                    SRAM
                    Shimano
            BikeType
                alternative
                    GravelBike
                    RoadBike
                    MountainBike
            Tyres
                alternative
                    WideTyres
                    SlimTyres
                    ExtraWideTyres
            Handlebar
                alternative
                    DropBar
                    FlatBar
constraints
    GravelBike => DropBar
    RoadBike => DropBar
    MountainBike => FlatBar
    RoadBike => SlimTyres
    MountainBike => ExtraWideTyres
    GravelBike => (WideTyres | SlimTyres)
    WideTyres => GravelBike
    ExtraWideTyres => MountainBike
    DropBar => (GravelBike | RoadBike)
    FlatBar => MountainBike

data.text: A factory has a production line that produces different types of chocolate. For normal chocolate, the melting-, mixing- and colling-station is needed. For the production of nut-chocolate, all mentioned statitions for nomal chocolate and an additional baking-station is required. All lines require a logistic-system and a packaging station.
data.code:
features
    Factory
        mandatory
            ChocolateType
                alternative
                    NormalChocolate
                    NutChocolate
            MeltingStation
            MixingStation
            CoolingStation
            LogisticSystem
            PackagingStation
        optional
            BakingStation
constraints
    NutChocolate => BakingStation
    BakingStation => NutChocolate

data.text: We have a tax-calculator within a billing-software. A calculator always needs following inputs: netto price, sum of products and the location of the buyer and seller. It then calculates follwing outputs: tax per product, brutto price and tax-rate. It also outputs logging data for audits: calculated base price and rule of calculation.
data.code:
features
    BillingSoftware
        mandatory
            TaxCalculator
                mandatory
                    Inputs
                        mandatory
                            NettoPrice
                            SumOfProducts
                            BuyerLocation
                            SellerLocation
                    Outputs
                        mandatory
                            TaxPerProduct
                            BruttoPrice
                            TaxRate
                    AuditLogging
                        mandatory
                            CalculatedBasePrice
                            RuleOfCalculation

data.text: There is a room-booking-service that manages different rooms within a hotel. A room has different basic features like: number of beds, view and size. There are also optional features like personal spa area or best-view option. A best-view option is only available for two-bed rooms. The managing system also manages the bookings. Each booking contains the start and end date and optional fees/bookings.
data.code:
features
    RoomBookingService
        mandatory
            Room
                mandatory
                    NumberOfBeds
                        alternative
                            OneBed
                            TwoBeds
                    View
                    Size
                optional
                    PersonalSpa
                    BestView
            BookingManagement
                mandatory
                    StartDate
                    EndDate
                optional
                    OptionalFees
constraints
    BestView => TwoBeds

data.text: A university course registration system manages student enrollments. All students must register for a minimum of 12 credits. Undergraduate students must select one 100-level Core course, while Graduate students must select a 500-level Seminar. Many courses have prerequisites; for example, 'Advanced AI' requires both 'Intro to AI' and 'Linear Algebra'. Some courses are mutually exclusive, like 'Statistics for Biology' and 'Statistics for Business'. The 'Robotics Lab' course is an optional elective with a hard enrollment cap of 20 students. Finally, the 'Thesis Defense' module is only available to students who have completed 60 credits and passed their 'Dissertation Proposal' review.
data.code:
features
    CourseRegistrationSystem
        mandatory
            Student
                alternative
                    Undergraduate
                    Graduate
        optional
            CoreCourse
            Seminar
            AdvancedAI
            IntroToAI
            LinearAlgebra
            StatisticsForBiology
            StatisticsForBusiness
            RoboticsLab
            ThesisDefense
            DissertationProposal
constraints
    Undergraduate => CoreCourse
    Graduate => Seminar
    AdvancedAI => IntroToAI & LinearAlgebra
    StatisticsForBiology => !StatisticsForBusiness
    ThesisDefense => DissertationProposal

data.text: A PC configurator tool guides users. The choice of CPU (e.g., Intel vs. AMD) dictates the required motherboard socket (e.g., LGA 1700 vs. AM5). The motherboard chipset (e.g., Z790) then determines the supported RAM type (DDR4 or DDR5). A high-end GPU (e.g., RTX 4090) has a minimum power requirement, constraining the choice of Power Supply (PSU) to 850W or higher. The GPU's physical length (e.g., 350mm) must also be compatible with the case's maximum GPU clearance. Finally, the case (e.g., ATX, Micro-ATX) must match the motherboard's form factor, and an optional large air cooler's height must be less than the case's CPU cooler clearance.
data.code:
features
    PCConfigurator
        mandatory
            CPU
                alternative
                    Intel
                    AMD
            Motherboard
                alternative
                    LGA1700
                    AM5
            RAM
                alternative
                    DDR4
                    DDR5
            GPU
                alternative
                    RTX4090
                    OtherGPU
            PSU
                alternative
                    "650W"
                    "850W"
                    "1000W"
            Case
                alternative
                    ATX
                    MicroATX
        optional
            LargeAirCooler
constraints
    Intel => LGA1700
    AMD => AM5
    AM5 => DDR5
    LGA1700 => (DDR4 | DDR5)
    RTX4090 => ("850W" | "1000W")
    ATX => (LGA1700 | AM5)
    MicroATX => (LGA1700 | AM5)

data.text: A CI/CD system defines deployment pipelines. All pipelines must run 'Build' and 'Unit Test' stages. A 'Staging' deployment is mandatory and can only run after 'Unit Test' passes. The 'Production' deployment requires the 'Staging' deployment to succeed, and also requires both 'Integration Test' and 'Security Scan' to pass. For 'Production', the user can select either a 'Blue/Green' or 'Canary' strategy. Choosing 'Canary' automatically adds a 'Monitoring' stage with a 'Rollback' trigger. Choosing 'Blue/Green' requires double the infrastructure resources during the swap. A separate 'Hotfix' pipeline can bypass 'Staging' and 'Integration Test', but requires a 'Manual QA Approval' step and must still pass the 'Security Scan'.
data.code:
features
    CICDSystem
        mandatory
            Build
            UnitTest
            StagingDeployment
        optional
            IntegrationTest
            SecurityScan
            ProductionDeployment
                mandatory
                    DeploymentStrategy
                        alternative
                            BlueGreen
                            Canary
                optional
                    Monitoring
                    Rollback
            HotfixPipeline
                mandatory
                    ManualQAApproval
constraints
    ProductionDeployment => IntegrationTest & SecurityScan
    Canary => Monitoring & Rollback
    HotfixPipeline => SecurityScan

data.text: A smart home automation system links devices based on rules. A rule has triggers, optional conditions, and actions. Rules must have priorities to resolve conflicts: the 'Movie Mode' scene (sets lights to 10%) must block the 'Morning' scene (sets lights to 100%) from running. Safety constraints are critical: the 'Smart Oven' action is disabled if 'Home Status' is 'Away'. Also, the 'Air Conditioner' action is dynamically disabled if any 'Window Sensor' reports 'Open' and only re-enables 5 minutes after all windows are closed.
data.code:
features
    SmartHomeSystem
        mandatory
            Rule
                mandatory
                    Trigger
                    Action
                optional
                    Condition
                    Priority
        optional
            MovieMode
            MorningScene
            SmartOven
            AirConditioner
            WindowSensor
            HomeStatus
                alternative
                    Home
                    Away
constraints
    MovieMode => !MorningScene
    SmartOven => !Away
    AirConditioner => !WindowSensor
